title: Windows release acceptance
goal: Verify the integrated release through actual Windows entry points, old and fresh data, and current documentation.
dependencies: Phase 5 has gate.status = passed and all required evidence recorded
preserve: Existing package names and colocated tray/dashboard binaries
Validated defaults, preferences and features from phases 1–5
implementation: Build locked workspace in release mode. Run the full required Windows tests serialized for native GUI.
Smoke run both binaries colocated in an isolated test location. Validate startup, restart, tray, desktop popup, WebView2 and settings persistence.
Exercise the complete journey with a real local AI vision model and isolated cleaner fixtures. Test fresh and pre-change configuration.
Verify keyboard, narrow width, reported DPI/geometry and typical Windows scaling. Run deterministic DPI tests where desktop scaling is fixed.
Update README with startup, default black–orange interface, color setting, hotkeys, Local AI requirements and cleaner behaviors.

Measure native Ctrl+Alt+O cold and warm separately with a healthy local model: hotkey to picker, mouse release to visible popup, and popup to recognized text. Keep release executable unmodified and cite observed Windows environment.

automated.case: Locked build and complete test suite
automated.run: cargo check --locked --workspace --all-targets; cargo build --locked --release --workspace; cargo test --locked --workspace -- --test-threads=1
automated.expected: All required Windows build/tests exit 0. Any failure or excluded required check must be resolved and rerun before marking passed.

automated.run: Run config, dashboard and tray tests on both a fresh location and saved 2.3.0 fixture.
automated.expected: Old keys and widget/hook behavior survive. Fresh defaults and selected accent after restart work.

automated.run: cargo test --locked -p cu-core --test dpi_scale; cargo test --locked -p claude-usage-dashboard --test dashboard_responsive -- --test-threads=1
automated.expected: DPI calculations and actual responsive Windows UI preserve access to primary actions and maintain capped fit behavior.

real_ui.steps: Run colocated release binaries with isolated profile/config. Open dashboard from tray, use hotkeys and restart. Verify no duplicate instance from repeated opening.
real_ui.expected: Tray, dashboard, popup and WebView2 work in the release build. Theme and preferences persist. The ordinary release build has no test-only feature enabled.

real_ui.steps: Try real OCR and Translation, view multi-profile quotas, and use synthetic cleaner and duplicate report. Verify with keyboard and a narrow window.
real_ui.expected: All expected outputs appear, errors remain actionable and deletion review is explicit. Record cold/warm selection and OCR timings, with app startup and model inference reported separately.

real_ui.steps: Follow build/startup instructions against the release output and inspect the visible app at narrow and normal widths.
real_ui.expected: Instructions match release behavior and user-visible labels. No runtime test is silently skipped.

test_milestones.scope: Run phase checks against the implementation and record exact commands, exit codes, results and environment
Review the code and test evidence. Report blocking findings or explicitly approve the reviewed diff
Independently inspect the diff, rerun the required checks and test the real Windows UI on isolated test data

test_milestones.owner: Phase Luna, continuous advisor and orchestrator
test_milestones.scope: For a fix, rerun affected tests and regressions, re-review the fix and repeat impacted independent UI checks

test_notes: Native tests must use isolated fixture state. Existing user tray/dashboard instances should not be stopped or modified by release verification without authorization. If their global window class blocks required tests, use a permitted isolated Windows session or record the blocker and hold the gate.

The release acceptance runtime uses colocated ordinary `--release` binaries without `e2e`. Physical input and external HWND/UI Automation do not rely on debug-only bridge hooks. Preserve fixture time zone for full core parity tests. Build and verify only; do not publish, tag, or change a user machine.

required: all required acceptance cases passed with evidence
independent orchestrator verification and real UI evidence
affected tests re-passed after any fix
gate.rule: Only the orchestrator can mark passed. Start the next phase only after this gate passes. The fix/retest milestone is inapplicable only when no post-review fix was needed and this is recorded.
